thread:
Priya: Quick async check-in — API gateway / ratepolicy canary / auth rotation. What I did: rolled the new thinburst ratepolicy to 5% canary on prod-edge, ran smoke through the burst harness. Observed a small spike in 429s on thinburst path (~10m window) and a ~20ms tail increase for /v1/generate. Blocker: some JWT rotations seem to be failing validation (kid mismatch) for a subset of clients. Today: debug auth rotation + rollback plan if needed, open PR to tighten ratepolicy fallback. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/gateway/pull/452

Sam: looking now. Can you paste the failing header from the logs? also which client ids are hitting this? @Sam :eyes:

Priya: grabbing logs — snippet below (redacted)
```
[2026-03-17T09:14:32Z] request_id=abc123 path=/v1/generate client_id=cust-77 auth_kid=kp_2026_03 expected_kid=kp_2026_02 validation_error=unknown_kid
[2026-03-17T09:14:33Z] request_id=abc124 path=/v1/embed client_id=cust-23 auth_kid=kp_2026_03 expected_kid=kp_2026_02 validation_error=unknown_kid
```
Those cust ids are from the dedicated pool customers using our legacy rotation shim.

Sam: ah — looks like the rotation shim didn't pick up the new public key on one of the edge nodes. Probably a config sync race. I can push a small fix to the shim to retry key fetch and add a metric. I'll open PR and link here.

Sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/auth-shim/pull/99 — adds 3 retries + backoff and emits auth.kid.sync_fail metric. Will also add an integration test to emulate stale keys.

Jared: fyi I tweaked routing weights for canary -> thinburst from 5% to 3% to reduce 429s while we sort the auth issue. Noticing a slight bump in tail latency on edge-17 for long sequences (~1.4k tokens). That node had the older kernel build.

Zoe: can we pin the canary to nodes with the latest runtime kernel? last time old kernels caused kv-cache thrash.

Jared: did a soft pin via tags to avoid edge-17 for the canary. Also kicked an infra restart on that host.

ci-bot: Canary deployment for gateway/ratepolicy v3.8.1: 5/5 checks passed, rollout at 3% -> adjusted to 3% per request. (build #2878) :white_check_mark:

Priya: thanks — I scheduled a follow-up sweep at 11:00 to re-run the burst harness and watch auth.kid.sync_fail. If auth fixes look good Sam, please add me as reviewer on auth-shim PR. Also can someone approve the gateway PR (link above) for the fallback tweak?

Sam: will add tests + tag @Priya on the auth-shim PR. For the gateway PR I added @Zoe for routing review and @Jared for infra impact.

Zoe: quick note to add to the runbook: when auth.kid.sync_fail spikes > 5/min, reduce canary to 0 and escalate to infra-oncall. I'll add a short paragraph and link it here: https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/gateway-canary#kid-sync

Priya: perfect — added an item to the canary checklist pointing at that runbook link. I'll re-run burst after Sam's patch lands. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
